name: tree_bird_cherry
prompt: A single new fruit tree for a cozy isometric farm game, drawn in exactly the same art style as the reference apple tree: same cozy hand-painted game art style with smooth clean dark-brown outlines and crisp details, lighting from the top-left and the same 3/4 isometric viewing angle. The trunk ends at the ground line with short, slightly flared roots, and 3 to 5 small soft grass tufts grow right at the foot of the trunk. These few tufts are tiny and only touch the base; do not draw a grass patch. They use the bright lime-green colors of the game lawn: mostly #7EBB09 and #6BAB06, lighter #9BC80C tips, darker #509705 in the shade, so the tree can stand directly on that lawn in the game. One object only, centered, filling most of the image, with an empty margin around it.
